<description>
The wallet merges preset (`MANUAL`) inputs with the automatic coin selection result in `spend.cpp`. With the mutant applied, the merged result is incorrectly reported as `MANUAL` instead of the algorithm that actually selected the coins.

The test checks both cases:
- Preset inputs merged into an automatic result should keep the automatic algorithm.
- A `MANUAL` result merged with another result should take the algorithm of the other result.

With the mutant applied, both checks fail with `manual != bnb`.
</description>
